verdict.rationale: Restate documents a human-in-the-loop pattern where workflows pause for human approval and resume when it arrives, even across restarts and infrastructure changes (restate-docs-48). It provides durable coordination primitives for external events and approvals (restate-docs-20, restate-docs-5, restate-docs-6). Waiting handlers are suspended to free resources and show up as suspended invocations (restate-docs-21, restate-docs-36, restate-docs-65). Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of multi-day wait durations or of how quickly a workflow resumes once the response arrives, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of long human-approval waits.
